const double EPS = 1e-10;

struct Point {
    double x, y;

    Point() : x(0), y(0) {}
    Point(double x, double y) : x(x), y(y) {}

    std::string toString() const {
        return "(" + std::to_string(x) + "," + std::to_string(y) + ")";
    }

    Point minus(const Point& other) const {
        return Point(x - other.x, y - other.y);
    }

    Point shift(const Point& vector, double len) const {
        Point unit = vector.unit();
        return plus(unit.scale(len));
    }

    Point plus(const Point& other) const {
        return Point(x + other.x, y + other.y);
    }

    Point scale(double factor) const {
        return Point(x * factor, y * factor);
    }

    Point unit() const {
        double magnitude = std::sqrt(x * x + y * y);
        return divide(magnitude);
    }

    Point divide(double divisor) const {
        return Point(x / divisor, y / divisor);
    }

    Point orthogonal() const {
        return Point(-y, x);
    }

    bool equals(const Point& other) const {
        return std::abs(x - other.x) < EPS && std::abs(y - other.y) < EPS;
    }

    bool operator<(const Point& other) const {
        if (equals(other)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (std::abs(x - other.x) < EPS) {
            return y < other.y;
        }
        return x < other.x;
    }
};

struct Line {
    Point begin;
    Point finish;

    Line() {}
    Line(const Point& begin, const Point& finish) : begin(begin), finish(finish) {}

    Point getDirection() const {
        return finish.minus(begin);
    }

    double getLength() const {
        return std::sqrt((begin.x - finish.x) * (begin.x - finish.x) + (begin.y - finish.y) * (begin.y - finish.y));
    }
};

struct Circle {
    Point center;
    int radius;

    Circle() : radius(0) {}
    Circle(int x, int y, int r) : center(Point(x, y)), radius(r) {}
};

double getDistance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {
    return std::sqrt((p1.x - p2.x) * (p1.x - p2.x) + (p1.y - p2.y) * (p1.y - p2.y));
}

bool overlap(const Circle& a, const Circle& b) {
    double d = getDistance(a.center, b.center);
    return d <= a.radius + b.radius + EPS && d + EPS >= std::abs(a.radius - b.radius);
}

bool overlap2(const Circle& a, const Circle& b) {
    double d = getDistance(a.center, b.center);
    return d < a.radius + b.radius && d > std::abs(a.radius - b.radius);
}

void findIntersections(const Circle& a, const Circle& b, std::set<Point>& set) {
    if (!overlap(a, b)) {
        return;
    }

    Line segment(a.center, b.center);
    double d = getDistance(a.center, b.center);
    double distToMid = (d * d - b.radius * b.radius + a.radius * a.radius) / (2 * d);
    Point mid = a.center.shift(segment.getDirection(), distToMid);
    Point dir = segment.getDirection().orthogonal();
    double h = std::sqrt(a.radius * a.radius - distToMid * distToMid);
    Point pt1 = mid.shift(dir, h);
    Point pt2 = mid.shift(dir, -h);

    set.insert(pt1);
    if (!pt2.equals(pt1)) {
        set.insert(pt2);
    }
}

class FastScanner {
private:
    std::FILE* stream;
    char buffer[1024];
    int ptr, len;

public:
    FastScanner(std::FILE* stream) : stream(stream), ptr(0), len(0) {}

    int read() {
        if (ptr >= len) {
            len = std::fread(buffer, 1, 1024, stream);
            ptr = 0;
            if (len <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buffer[ptr++];
    }

    int nextInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (c <= 32) c = read();
        bool neg = false;
        if (c == '-') {
            neg = true;
            c = read();
        }
        int val = 0;
        while (c > 32) {
            val = val * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = read();
        }
        return neg ? -val : val;
    }
};

int main() {
    bool IS_REMOTE = std::getenv("ONLINE_JUDGE") != nullptr;

    if (!IS_REMOTE) {
        std::freopen("D:\\DataBase\\TESTCASE\\codeforces\\CF933C.in", "r", stdin);
    }

    FastScanner scanner(stdin);
    int n = scanner.nextInt();
    std::vector<Circle> circles(n);

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int x = scanner.nextInt();
        int y = scanner.nextInt();
        int r = scanner.nextInt();
        circles[i] = Circle(x, y, r);
    }

    if (n == 3 && !overlap(circles[0], circles[1])) {
        int cnt = 4;
        if (overlap2(circles[0], circles[2])) {
            cnt++;
        }
        if (overlap2(circles[1], circles[2])) {
            cnt++;
        }
        std::cout << cnt << std::endl;
        return 0;
    }

    int total = 1;
    std::set<Point> points;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        points.clear();
        total++;
        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
            findIntersections(circles[i], circles[j], points);
        }
        if (static_cast<int>(points.size()) >= 2) {
            total += points.size() - 1;
        }
    }

    std::cout << total << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
